build_prompt_for_evolution: build a prompt for the LLM with current program code, metrics, and evolution history
set_custom_templates: set custom system and user template names for the prompt sampler
identify_improvement_areas: identify improvement areas by comparing current fitness score against previous program attempts
format_evolution_history: format the evolution history with previous attempts, top programs, and diverse inspiration programs
render_artifacts_with_security_filter: render program artifacts as formatted text sections with optional security filtering to redact secrets
